spans.s:
योत्स्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, about to fight, ready to
fight.

योतु योतु, उस्, m. (probably fr. rt. 2. यु),
= परि-माण, measure in general; cleaning; puri-
fying, separating (?fr. rt. 1. यु).

योत्र योत्र, अम्, n. (fr. rt. 2. यु), = योक्त्र,
a fastening, tie, band, cord, rope, line; the tie or
cord that fastens the yoke of the plough to the neck
of the ox.
—योत्र-प्रमाद, अस्, m., N. of a work.
